_comment: Generic Hindu-Buddhist candi cosmology (kaki/tubuh/atap = Bhurloka/Bhuvarloka/Svarloka; finial = Mount Meru) -- not a claim about any specific named real-world site.

hotspots.text_en: The lowest tier represents Bhurloka, the world of ordinary human life, in the three-part cosmology many Hindu-Buddhist candi in Java and Bali follow. It is also the structural foundation carrying the whole building's weight.
hotspots.text_id: Tingkat terbawah melambangkan Bhurloka, alam kehidupan manusia biasa, dalam kosmologi tiga tingkat yang dianut banyak candi Hindu-Buddha di Jawa dan Bali. Bagian ini juga menjadi fondasi struktural yang menopang seluruh bangunan.

hotspots.text_en: The body represents Bhuvarloka, the middle realm. In a real candi this section usually holds the inner chamber (garbhagriha) where a statue of a deity was placed.
hotspots.text_id: Tubuh candi melambangkan Bhuvarloka, alam pertengahan. Pada candi sesungguhnya, bagian ini biasanya menyimpan bilik utama (garbhagriha) tempat arca dewa diletakkan.

hotspots.text_en: Real candi walls are often carved with narrative reliefs -- story panels meant to be 'read' by walking around the building, teaching religious epics to visitors who could not read.
hotspots.text_id: Dinding candi asli sering dipahat relief naratif -- panel cerita yang dimaksudkan untuk 'dibaca' sambil mengelilingi bangunan, mengajarkan kisah keagamaan kepada pengunjung yang tidak bisa membaca.

hotspots.text_en: The tiered roof represents Svarloka, the heavens. Each receding tier steps the building visually toward the sky, toward the finial at its peak.
hotspots.text_id: Atap bertingkat melambangkan Svarloka, alam para dewa. Setiap tingkat yang mengecil membawa bangunan secara visual naik menuju langit, menuju puncak di ujungnya.

hotspots.text_en: The finial crowns the temple and, in Hindu-Buddhist cosmology, represents the peak of Mount Meru -- the mythical cosmic mountain the entire candi is a model of.
hotspots.text_id: Puncak menahkotai candi dan, dalam kosmologi Hindu-Buddha, melambangkan puncak Gunung Meru -- gunung kosmis mitologis yang direpresentasikan oleh seluruh bangunan candi.
